strengths: Strong open-source GIS experience with GISCollective
Proven ability to work across diverse tech stacks and languages
Demonstrated passion for testing, tooling, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No commercial C++ or Rust experience in routing or geospatial data pipelines
Lacks demonstrated expertise in distributed systems, fault tolerance, or navigation data consistency
Primary technologies used (DLang, Node.js) are not aligned with job's core stack
